p1:main.reviewer: 봉인 원문 독립 검산자 + 리뷰어 A 결과 대조
p1:main.conclusion: Q2 emitter current = IC1/4, so Gx=gm2+1/rπ2=gm1/4. Miller ac gain x/base=-4 versus -1 for conventional cascode. Pole magnitudes in rad/s are 1/[(RB||rπ1)(Cπ1+5Cμ1)], (gm2+1/rπ2)/[Cπ2+Cμ3+1.25Cμ1], and 1/(RC Cμ2). Add collector–substrate or load capacitances at their respective nodes if retained. Miller input loading increases. Frequencies in Hz divide by 2π.
p1:main.evidence: evidence/p1-sympy.py, evidence/p1-result.txt — 유한 β에서 gm2+1/rπ2=gm1/4. 저자의 큰 β와 접합용량 포함 모델에서 일치.

p2:main.reviewer: 봉인 원문 독립 검산자 + 리뷰어 A 결과 대조
p2:main.conclusion: ID2=1 mA. Ignoring body transconductance gives gm1=20 mS and gm2=10 mS, AY/X=-2. Miller pole magnitudes ωX=1/[100(Cgs1+3Cgd1)], ωY=1/[100(Cdb1+Cgs2+Csb2+Cgd3+Cdb3+1.5Cgd1)]. Angular to Hz: divide by 2π. Source–bulk Csb2 may be omitted in a gate-capacitance-only or source-tied-body model (also omit the other junction terms in a gate-only model).
p2:main.evidence: evidence/p2-sympy.py, evidence/p2-result.txt — 두 독립 극점 수식 일치. 몸체 AC 접지와 gmb 무시를 함께 적용.

p3:main.reviewer: 봉인 원문 독립 검산자 + 리뷰어 A 결과 대조
p3:main.conclusion: Under odd-mode differential excitation the common-source node is virtual ground. For a matched pair with large ro and negligible body effect, ωg=1/{Rs[Cgs1+(1+gm1/gm3)Cgd1]}, ωx=gm3/[Cdb1+Cgs3+Csb3+(1+gm3/gm1)Cgd1], ωo=1/[RD(Cgd3+Cdb3)]. Add any externally specified load to output capacitance. For identical cascode and input gm, each Miller factor is 2. The source–bulk term depends on body connection/model.
p3:main.evidence: evidence/p3-sympy.py, evidence/p3-result.txt — 독립 반회로의 세 분모 및 교과서 11.155–157 일치.

p4:1.reviewer: 봉인 원문 독립 검산자 + 리뷰어 A 결과 대조
p4:1.conclusion: With grounded bulk and neglecting gmb, the sources of M2 and M3 both terminate at x: Gx=gm2+gm3, a=gm1/Gx. Approximate ωg=1/{RG[Cgs1+(1+a)Cgd1]}, ωx=Gx/[Cdb1+Cgs2+Csb2+Cgs3+Csb3+(1+1/a)Cgd1], and ωo=gm4/(Cgd2+Cdb2+Cgs4+Cdb4). Diode-connected M4 has zero Cgd4 voltage.
p4:1.evidence: evidence/p4-sympy.py, evidence/p4-result.txt — 원 스캔 (a) 및 독립 Gx=gm2+gm3 식 일치.

p4:2.reviewer: 봉인 원문 독립 검산자 + 리뷰어 A 결과 대조
p4:2.conclusion: For matched differential halves, same-side subtraction at input and output, and no gmb, define G=gm3+go3+go5+go1, a=gm1/G, Co=Cdb1+Cgs3+Csb3+Cgd5+Cdb5. ωg≈1/{Rs[Cgs1+(1+a)Cgd1]}, ωo≈G/[Co+(1+1/a)Cgd1]. H_Miller≈−a/[(1+s/ωg)(1+s/ωo)]. Exact H=(sCgd1−gm1)/{[1+sRs(Cgs1+Cgd1)][G+s(Co+Cgd1)]+sRs Cgd1(gm1−sCgd1)}, with RHP zero at gm1/Cgd1. Reverse output definition changes numerator sign. Grounded-bulk gmb3 adds to G if retained. Junction capacitances depend on body model.
p4:2.evidence: evidence/p4-sympy.py, evidence/p4-result.txt — 독립 유한 ro 행렬에서 DC 이득·Miller 극점과 일치. 정확 RHP zero는 Miller 근사에서 생략.

p6:main.conclusion: With β=R2/(R1+R2), Y/X=(1/β)·A1β/(1+A1β). The high loop gain leaves fractional error 1/(1+A1β), so XF≈X and Y/X→1+R1/R2.
